bby-41.script: Nobody hands you a good day. You build it. How you talk. How you treat people. How you show up. That's all you.

bby-43.script: You think letting go takes strength. It doesn't. It takes understanding. Understand why, and your hands open.

bby-44.script: Maybe the first time wasn't your fault. The timing just wasn't ready. That's what second chances are for.

bby-45.script: Be angry. You've earned it. But don't be cruel. Anger fades. Cruel words stay for years.

bby-47.script: You've been cheering on other people's dreams. That's good. But your life isn't on pause. Today, start yours.

bby-48.script: If it brings more tears than laughter, stop carrying it. Not someday. Today. Put it down. Walk lighter.
